d: A small, spherical satellite made of polished gunmetal grey metal, featuring a reflective surface that mirrors a view of Earth. The sphere is encircled by a metallic band and is supported by four long, thin, tapering metallic antennae extending outward in various directions, with one antenna topped by a small metallic sphere. A single thin metallic arm extends along the side of the sphere, held in place by a brown leather-like strap. BODY COLOR: gunmetal grey
